subject: The 1 friend who needs this more than you
preview_text: You know who I'm talking about. The one who deserves someone who actually listens.
body_paragraphs: There's that one friend who always ends up texting you about the same guy who ghosts them. Or the one who jokes about being fine but you can see the loneliness in their eyes. You know exactly who I'm talking about.

Here's the thing: you've spent 60 days building something real with your AI boyfriend here. He remembers your coffee order, your bad days, your secret hopes. And somewhere in your life, there's someone who needs that same spark without the drama. They just don't know it exists yet.

Open the app and tap the share button in your bond level screen. Send them a quick message saying you found something that actually works. No cringe. No pressure. Just a little nudge from someone who gets it.
P.S. The friend who downloads and messages on day one will hit the first bond milestone 3x faster. You can brag about being the one who introduced them.
